goal: Rank missing source access by expected contribution to verified 3D.SK buyer opportunities without weakening truth gates.

entries.missing_source: Approved Upwork marketplaceJobPostingsSearch access or a user-owned alert mailbox transport
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Only an approved API use case may request Upwork; the fallback may process alerts already delivered to the user's mailbox but must not open or scrape Upwork automatically.
entries.required_authorization_or_credential: Approved OAuth2 API token and tenant ID, or a read-only mailbox label plus HMAC ingest secret for discovery-only alerts
entries.detail_verification: Open the exact Upwork buyer job detail and prove active status, team eligibility, deliverable, budget provenance and application route.

entries.missing_source: Production-qualified TED Search API query pack
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Published notices are available for reuse through the documented anonymous API; respect service caps and schema revisions.
entries.detail_verification: Retrieve the exact notice and latest revision; verify buyer, lot, deadline, 3D deliverable, geography and supplier eligibility.

entries.missing_source: NEN designated XML/open-data route for MK CR, National Museum and NPU profiles
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Do not automate frontend APIs; use only the machine interface designated by NIPEZ rules.
entries.detail_verification: Bind XML/open-data identity to the exact NEN public detail and verify current deadline, contracting authority and explicit 3D cultural deliverable.

entries.missing_source: Museum and regional E-ZAK native alert feed
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Public HTML alone is not automation permission; do not use private XHR endpoints.
entries.required_authorization_or_credential: Free supplier account/email alert or written feed permission
entries.detail_verification: Resolve every alert to the exact public contract_display detail and verify active procurement facts and 3D scope.

entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Use the official state dataset, not an undocumented third-party or frontend endpoint.
entries.detail_verification: Match notice/revision to the exact UVO detail; prove active status, public buyer, lot and relevant 3D deliverable.

entries.missing_source: JOSEPHINE native tender alerts or documented public feed
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Do not scrape authenticated pages, bypass login or infer an undocumented API.
entries.required_authorization_or_credential: Free account alert or written provider permission
entries.detail_verification: Open the exact /sk/tender/<id>/summary page and verify authority, deadline, documents, scope and participation route.

entries.missing_source: Higher-coverage Find a Tender OCDS precision sample
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Open Government Licence; respect API pagination, rate limits and no automatic retry.
entries.detail_verification: Verify latest OCDS release and exact public notice, deadline, supplier geography and remote post-production feasibility.

entries.missing_source: Higher-coverage Contracts Finder OCDS precision sample
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Use documented read endpoint; on the documented rate-limit response stop without automatic retry.
entries.detail_verification: Verify the exact first-party Notice URL, active deadline, buyer, lot and remote-compatible 3D production scope.

entries.missing_source: Open calls, funded recipients and planned procurement from MK CR, FPU, MK SR and EEA Grants
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: A programme page is not a buyer order; closed calls and projects without explicit 3D scope must be rejected.
entries.detail_verification: Prove an open call or named funded recipient, explicit 3D deliverable and a direct supplier/partner route; classify only as POTENTIAL_LEAD until procurement exists.

entries.missing_source: User-owned LinkedIn alerts resolved to original buyer or ATS details
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: No LinkedIn login scraping; LinkedIn URL remains a signal and cannot become sales provenance.
entries.required_authorization_or_credential: User-owned alert mailbox/relay and HMAC ingest secret
entries.detail_verification: Resolve to an original employer, buyer, marketplace or ATS detail and reapply all buyer/studio/freshness gates.

entries.missing_source: Approved commercial Reddit Data API access
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Commercial use requires Reddit approval/agreement; do not use .json or RSS as a workaround.
entries.required_authorization_or_credential: Approved OAuth token and commercial API agreement
entries.detail_verification: Require current HIRING/PAID buyer post, reject FOR HIRE sellers, and verify exact post status and team eligibility.

entries.missing_source: Authorized Bluesky and selected Mastodon search signals
entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: Respect API limits and deletions; social posts cannot serve as final buyer provenance without an eligible exact source.
entries.required_authorization_or_credential: Revocable Bluesky app password; Mastodon read:search token and selected instance
entries.detail_verification: Resolve each signal to an exact original buyer detail and then apply the normal truth contract.

entries.legal_or_tos_constraint: No discovery of private servers/channels; ingest only events delivered to explicitly invited bots.
entries.required_authorization_or_credential: Bot credentials, channel IDs and owner authorization
entries.detail_verification: Treat messages as locked signals until an exact public or authorized buyer brief proves every sales field.
